card.name: Connection and attachment steps for devices
card.fires_on: Words about connecting or securing device parts (connection, connections, until the needle fits, thoroughly) in syringe, luer and infusion-set instructions. Also a few words inside or before interaction warnings.

modes.label: Device connection wording
modes.description: The word connection or a linking word in steps for attaching syringes, needles, luer ports or infusion sets.
modes.example: Visually inspect the glass syringe-needle or glass syringe-NLAD<< connection>> before and during drug administration.

modes.label: Linking word in a step
modes.description: A small word such as until, the or is inside a how-to-attach instruction.
modes.example: Step 2: Attach a sterile Luer Lock needle by twisting in a clockwise direction until<< the>> needle fits securely on the syringe.

modes.label: Interaction warning wording
modes.description: A word partway through a contraindication phrase or a long medical word.
